# Tarmeem Sharqiya — Sharqia Paints & Decor (Renovation & Finishing) | أصباغ وديكورات الشرقية ترميم وتشطيب

> Painting, decor, renovation and finishing contractor in Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province: Dammam, Khobar, Dhahran, Qatif, Jubail and Al-Ahsa, plus Saihat, Safwa, Ras Tanura and Anak. Interior & exterior painting with Jotun and Al Jazeera paints, German chipboard with WPC wood and UV marble alternatives, gypsum board and wallpaper, Korean PVC car shades and fences, and turnkey villa renovation. Named materials in a written quote, free inspection, 68 real completed projects documented with photos, and a written guarantee of up to 10 years on shades and roof insulation. The website is fully bilingual: Arabic at the root URLs, English under /en/.

Contact: phone and WhatsApp +966 53 032 0587 (https://wa.me/966530320587). Free site inspection and written, itemised quote inside the service areas listed below. Final prices are confirmed after the free inspection; the pricing page publishes indicative market ranges for the Eastern Province.

## Services (English)

- [Interior & Exterior Painting](https://tarmeemsharqiya.com/en/service-painting): الدهانات الداخلية والخارجية
- [Chipboard, WPC & Marble Substitute](https://tarmeemsharqiya.com/en/service-chipboard): الشيبورد وبديل الخشب والرخام
- [Villa Renovation & Finishing](https://tarmeemsharqiya.com/en/service-renovation): ترميم وتشطيب الفلل والملاحق
- [Gypsum Board, Wallpaper & Foam](https://tarmeemsharqiya.com/en/service-gypsum-wallpaper): جبس بورد وورق جدران وفوم
- [Car Shades, Screens & Qarmid](https://tarmeemsharqiya.com/en/service-shades): مظلات وسواتر وقرميد
